messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: SLO breach detected — streaming p95 and p99 elevated in us-west-2 (alert #INC-2026-172). Auto-paging eng-oncall.

emma: oncall here, looking. which clusters are flaring?

raj: seeing tail spikes on serving-gpu-3 and prefill-2. p95 ~2400ms (baseline 120ms), p99 ~9.8s. streaming stalls visible, chunk callbacks timing out.

sofia: traces show long pauses in decode stage plus lots of KV cache eviction events. eviction rate spiked ~5x at 17:03 UTC.

emma: customer impact? any errors or just latency?

liam: partial impact — 12 customers reported degraded streaming (disconnects + truncated responses). No full service outages. CS triage opened a ticket and notified tier-1 customers.

alex: prefill vs decode imbalance suspected: prefill worker count surged, filled many small keys, causing fragmentation on slab allocator. decode tasks then waited on KV reads (hot key thrash).

raj: query we looked at:
```
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (shard)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

p99 map matches spikes.

sofia: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) throttle prefill path globally to reduce alloc churn, 2) temporarily increase slab reclaim aggressiveness on affected shards, 3) route inbound streaming to fallback model variant in us-west-2 for 10m.

emma: thumbs-up to that. raj, can you run the prefill throttle? alex, patch slab reclaim config?

raj: applying prefill throttle now: `./admin throttle set prefill global 0.3` — will report in 30s.

alex: bumping reclaim aggressiveness on shard range [8-11] via infra flag. Patching and hot-reloading now.

sofia: starting a short reroute: route-policy set us-west-2 streaming fallback:small-latency for 10m. This will reduce load on main path.

emma: monitoring p95/p99 and streaming successful chunk rate. keep messages short — oncall handoff in 40m.

raj: prefill throttle deployed — eviction rate dropped 60% in first 45s. decode queue length trending down.

sofia: slab reclaim changes reloaded. I see fewer fragmentation events in the allocator logs. p95 down to ~180ms, p99 ~1.1s and still improving.

liam: CS update: customers on streaming now report much fewer dropouts. pushing update to affected accounts.

emma: good. leave routing in place for 10m, then we slowly remove throttle and monitor. schedule postmortem and long-term items: slab allocator defrag job, prefill rate smoothing, and improved hotspot detection alerts.

raj: filing follow-up: PM-2026-233 (root cause: KV slab fragmentation + prefill surge -> decode wait thrash). I'll include metric dashboards and the queries we used.

sofia: adding suggestion to Optimize: consider soft quotas per-customer prefill to avoid global churn.

emma: thanks team. handing off to next oncall @raj in 40m. incident-bot: mark incident partial-resolved, continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:
